test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

He was __quaking in his boots__ when he had to give a speech on the stage.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"quaking in his boots"** means to tremble with fear. (डर के मारे कांपना) • **Example: **She was quaking in her boots when she saw the huge spider in her room. • **"Fear" **refers to an unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm. (डर) • **Example: **He felt a surge of fear as he walked through the dark alley. Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is **'To tremble with fear.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To tremble in excitement** (उत्साह में कांपना): To shake slightly due to excitement. • **Example:** He was **trembling in excitement **as he opened the gift. • **To shake in happiness** (खुशी में कांपना): To shake slightly because of being very happy. • **Example:** She was **shaking in happiness** when she heard the good news. • **To shake in excitement** (उत्साह में कांपना): Similar to trembling in excitement, it means to shake slightly due to excitement. • **Example:** The children were **shaking in excitement **as they waited for the magician to start the show. 1b3:Tb90, The correct answer is **Option 4)**
